target.outcome: County ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality rates among adults age 65+ (article target); bounded fit uses all-stroke mortality age 35+
target.population: US residents; article target age 65+, bounded outcome source age 35+
target.effect_scale: Article-native additive deaths per 100,000 per 1 ug/m3; no native ratio was fitted
target.exposure_assignment: County daily EPA Downscaler predictions averaged over 2016-2020
target.model: OLS with HC3 uncertainty in bounded sensitivity
target.named_outcome_source: CDC Interactive Atlas of Heart Disease and Stroke

substitutions.reason: Only the latter was recovered as a public, fit-ready county bulk product.
Provides broad county coverage; monitor probes had uneven station coverage.
Remaining article covariates were not recovered before bounded fit.

coverage.notes: Per-county PM2.5 days ranged 1461-1827; outcome/exposure intersection had 3103 counties.

blockers: Article-specific age-65+ ischemic and hemorrhagic outcome panel and full adjustment set not recovered. The completed fit is therefore a bounded sensitivity only.

design_provenance.assignment_method: county-level annual aggregation of public modeled daily county predictions
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: mean of CDC Tracking Network daily county EPA Downscaler PM2.5 predictions across 2016-01-01 through 2020-12-31

coverage_policy.evidence: CDC query returned days observed; retain and report per-county denominator rather than exclude.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: After feasibility probes, use a public county-complete modeled surface for the bounded sensitivity rather than substitute monitor assignments with uneven county coverage. This changes the source/construct from the article-unspecified county annual PM2.5 to CDC EPA Downscaler county estimates and is explicitly labeled.
evidence_basis: CDC describes 53mz-4zqd as EPA Downscaler modeled county PM2.5 2001-2022.
3109 counties returned; daily counts range to complete 1827 study days.
AERIS OpenAQ historical archive probe in Los Angeles recovered 2018 PM2.5 and 96.7% network day coverage, while the Autauga probe had no stations; monitor-only nationwide coverage would be unequal.

effects.label: Bounded adjusted sensitivity; model-implied relative outcome change at sample-mean outcome for +10 ug/m3
effects.contrast: 10 ug/m3; presentation-only rescaling at mean outcome, not article estimand
